text_block_list.text: The Sprinters Stakes draws to a close...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
With Каррен Тян's victory over Nishino
Flower!
However, the fact that she didn't
overwhelm her
in terms of cuteness
dampens Каррен Тян's
excitement a bit.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
We return to town to find that Curren
Chan's race
with Нишино Флауэр has
gone viral, launching her
Umatter fame
skyward.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Seeing how worked up everyone is gives
Curren
Chan a hint about what direction
to go moving
forward.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
With Нишино Флауэр's victory... Yet
despite the
loss, Каррен Тян seems
happy. She tells me this
is proof that she
can still become cuter.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
